rules: correct is a boolean; true and false are facts, not model judgements.
error_cause is optional only when correct is false; it is forbidden on a correct attempt.
topics contains one or more unique canonical Knowledge Topic IDs.

case_attempt.meaning: One submitted case-question attempt with optional aggregate and capability score evidence.
rules: A case is not represented by a boolean correct field.
score_earned and score_possible are an optional pair; when present, possible is positive and earned is within bounds.
capabilities contains one or more unique Case Capability IDs.
capability_scores is optional. Each evidence item must reference a capability in capabilities and has its own earned/possible pair.
A capability reference without score evidence creates no capability metric.

study_session.meaning: One measured learning session; it does not imply quality, focus, mastery, or completion.
rules: occurred_at is the session start instant and must equal started_at.
At least one of ended_at and duration_minutes is required.
duration_minutes is a non-negative integer; when both fields are present it must equal the exact elapsed whole minutes.
topics are optional context only and do not create attempt or coverage evidence.

common_fields.event_id: Non-empty stable event identity. Duplicate IDs are a validation error; replay never silently deduplicates.
common_fields.event_type: One of the three event type keys above.
common_fields.occurred_at: Timezone-aware ISO 8601 date-time. Naive timestamps are invalid.

rules: The reference is source-oriented and is not coupled to the Golden Set.
source_path is repository-relative; absolute paths and parent traversal are forbidden.
No question stem, options, answer, analysis, OCR or full text may be stored.

error_causes.rule: The enum is one cause per incorrect comprehensive attempt. A missing cause is an unclassified error.

replay_semantics.ordering: Sort every event by occurred_at converted to UTC, then event_id using ascending lexical order.
replay_semantics.identity: event_id is globally unique across all event types; session_id is unique among study_session events.
replay_semantics.immutability: Facts are append-only. Correction/superseding events are future work; v0.1 has no in-place mutation or correction event.
replay_semantics.topic_metrics: Comprehensive attempts only. Each directly referenced topic receives one evidence count; parent closure is not copied into topic attempt counts.
replay_semantics.coverage: Question topics from comprehensive and case attempts contribute distinct coverage. A referenced L3 also covers its L2 and L1 parents.
replay_semantics.case_metrics: Case attempt_count counts each case event once. Aggregate score sums earned and possible across scored case events. Capability metrics count only capability-level score evidence.
replay_semantics.null_semantics: accuracy and score_ratio are null when their denominator has no evidence; no evidence is not a zero result.
replay_semantics.precision: Counts and scores remain integers. Ratios are serialized as numbers rounded to four decimal places using deterministic half-up rounding.

state_fields.global: Comprehensive attempt_count, correct_count, incorrect_count and correct_count / attempt_count accuracy.
state_fields.case: Case attempt_count, scored_attempt_count, summed score_earned, summed score_possible and weighted score_ratio.
state_fields.topics: Every taxonomy topic is present with attempt_count, correct_count, incorrect_count and accuracy; unattempted topics have accuracy null.
state_fields.capabilities: Every capability is present with score evidence counts/sums, score_ratio and evidence_status; unscored references remain insufficient_evidence.
state_fields.errors: error_count, classified_error_count, unclassified_error_count, error_count_by_cause and cause_count / classified_error_count mix.
state_fields.coverage: For L1/L2/L3, covered, total and covered / total ratio.
state_fields.study: session_count and the sum of duration_minutes as study_minutes.

rules: A fixture with expected_error must fail replay with that validation category.
A fixture without expected_error must replay successfully.
